test_title: PYST 9 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence :

The manager was asked to write a report __**in a quick, detailed and in a thorough manner.**__

options.text: in a quick, detailed, and thorough manner
in a quick, detailed and in thorough manner
in a quick, detailing and thorough manner

solution:
The correct answer is '**in a quick, detailed, and thorough manner**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence requires parallelism in the list of adjectives to maintain grammatical correctness and readability.
 
• The phrase "**in a quick, detailed, and thorough manner**" follows proper parallel structure, which means all the adjectives are consistent in form.
 
• Options 2
